name: ELPA
description: Builds ELPA 2026.02.002 (OpenMP, AVX2 kernels) into /opt/wise against the image's MPI, ScaLAPACK and OpenBLAS: the distributed eigensolver of Quantum ESPRESSO and CP2K. On the CUDA base image the GCC build adds NVIDIA GPU kernels, and an nvfortran build (no OpenMP, SDK BLAS) goes to /opt/wise/nvhpc for nvfortran programs.

cudaArch.description: Compute capability of the GPU kernels on the CUDA base image (sm_<value>).
